mapper.update: UPDATE `document` SET parent_id = #{parentId}, title = #{title}, file_name = #{fileName}, status = #{status}, current_version_no = #{currentVersionNo}, index_input_revision = #{indexInputRevision}, idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, current_version_no, index_input_revision, idempotency_key, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, current_version_no, index_input_revision, idempotency_key, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, current_version_no, index_input_revision, idempotency_key, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE document_code = #{documentCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, current_version_no, index_input_revision, idempotency_key, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, document_code, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_user_id, title, file_name, document_type, status, current_version_no, index_input_revision, idempotency_key, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND status IN (2, 4) ORDER BY file_name ASC, id ASC
